payload.text: hv's rulings of 2026-11-13, given to vc in the live channel (vc's window, as answers to vc's question dialog), recorded by vc as mediator. On ST0003/WP06's rollout, asked how to handle the 27 running sessions and when to start, in hv's wording: "I can't do this now. It will need to wait until later. I propose that we just go ahead with the relase anyway and then fix forward later on." On when to cut, in hv's wording: "Cut now, as long as the other tests on both rhad and kovacs have passed." vc's acts the same day: 0.1.9 is cut before the rollout; ST0003/WP06, ST0002's AC-08.3 (hv's look at the panel in Herdr) and ISSUE:0003's close wait for the rollout, whose steps are in vc's closing sequence; until then nobody runs ccusage use or ccusage which --use on 0.1.9, either of which begins it (0.1.9 otherwise reads each login where 0.1.8 left it, and ccusage dir still prints the active profile's directory); dc runs the project's gates on kovacs before the cut, and rhadamanth's run is the cut's own gates.
